name: Suzune
source:
[i]"I could never have dreamed of being treated so kindly by a lady of your standing."[/i]

A young girl who works as a geisha in the entertainment district. Meets the heroine through an unexpected turn of events, and eventually befriends her.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/itehari/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
